description: This file contains implementation functions for a TLS Hso Client Object, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and removal routines. It also shows setup of vtable-like function pointers and references to internal components related to TLS client operations.

classes.name: TLS_HSO_CLIENT_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the TLS Hso Client Object containing state and function pointers for TLS client operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE TlsHsoClientCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new TLS Hso Client Object, initializing its fields and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsHsoClientRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the TLS Hso Client Object and performs cleanup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsHsoClientEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls necessary subordinate objects, notably setting the state timer invoke function.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsHsoClientInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the object, including setting object identifiers, function pointers, and TLS client state variables.
